sentence: This project studies the cells that make up the meninges and the pathways that control how they develop and work.
This project tries to find out how lipid changes harm oligodendrocyte maturation and myelination in mice with Spinocerebellar ataxia type 3.
This project looks for signs of damage and molecular changes in the motor cortex of people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
This project tries to find out how a pathway active during cocaine abstinence works and how to target it to promote recovery.
This project uses mouse models to test whether a human protein drives cancer metastasis and to learn how the protein works.
This project builds imaging tools based on optical coherence tomography to see nerves during surgery and blood flow in the human retina.
This project studies how the capsid of a gene therapy vector shapes epigenetic signatures and gene activity in different species.
This project builds a tool to image toxic metals and platinum drug metal in single cells of lung tumor tissue to study drug resistance.
This project studies the cell and molecular controls of vascular calcification, an abnormal deposition of bone-like mineral in the valve and vasculature.
This project studies how nicotine vaping during pregnancy alters lung immune cells and leads to allergic asthma.
This project studies how Argonaute proteins use small RNAs to control genes and growth in organisms.
This project tests whether a biodegradable nanoparticle aimed at a receptor improves chemotherapy and immunotherapy for pancreatic cancer.
This project studies how cell-free DNA in a liquid biopsy can be used to follow sepsis over time.
This project develops measures and analysis methods to study disparities in Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias.
This project studies how mindfulness-based interventions build resilience to stigma and support recovery from alcohol use disorder.
This project compares the amygdala and subgenual anterior cingulate cortex of patients and controls and tests genetic effects in mouse models.
This project studies how sea surface temperature and plankton influence Vibrio in coastal waters and builds a forecasting platform.
This project builds an AI approach and a risk score questionnaire that let non-experts diagnose epilepsy, and tests it in an underserved area.
